title: Staff Vacancies
metaDescription: Current teaching and support staff vacancies at Rosehill College, Papakura. See open roles, requirements and how to apply to join our team.

sections.heading: Join Our Team at Rosehill College
sections.lede: Explore exciting career opportunities at Rosehill College, where we are committed to fostering a dynamic and supportive environment for both students and staff. Whether you are passionate about teaching, administration, or support roles, we invite you to be a part of our vibrant educational community and contribute to the success and growth of our students.

sections.heading: How to Apply
sections.html:
The terms and conditions, including base salary, for teaching positions are set by the Secondary Teachers’ Collective Agreement. The base salary for trained and registered teachers ranges from $62,862 to $105,686, depending on the applicant’s qualifications and experience. An individual’s actual base salary will be established through a salary assessment once a position is confirmed.

A Rosehill College Application Form must accompany your CV and cover letter:

* [Application Form — Teachers](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1miND8DSPlA6e7gO_ERSzjtMx1Dqex9xi/view)
* [Application Form — Relief Teachers](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NVlwVmamPH2Oz3gNWFHPTuK_JfZ_cqSw/view)
* [Application Form — Support Staff](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Wi2jvSdskRLpeZpBWdD8TYesLclYjwD9/view)

#### **HOD Food Technology and Hospitality 2 MU · Full Time/Permanent · Start date: As soon as available** We are seeking a well organised, innovative and inspiring leader of Food Technology and Hospitality. The successful candidate will be able to raise student achievement with a focus on student wellbeing and positive learning relationships. **Applicants should have a current New Zealand teacher registration and a working knowledge of the New Zealand curriculum. The successful candidate will have:** * a genuine passion for teaching and a clear understanding of NCEA * experience in designing programmes of work * experience in the assessment of Achievement Standards * experience in differentiated teaching at the junior and senior levels * ability to lead a team to work collaboratively to raise student achievement * knowledge of the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and ensure te reo me ōna Tikanga are upheld * relational practices to tautoko positive relationships within our kura A commitment to mana ōrite mō te mātauranga māori, and cultural responsiveness is also essential. ***Applicants must have NZ working rights.*** Posted Date: 26 August 2026
#### **Kaiako Reo Māori · Full Time/Permanent · Start date: January 2027** He tangata ngākaunui koe ki tō tātou reo rangatira? ki te puawaitanga i te tipuranga o te tamaiti hoki? Anei te tono mōu. E kimi ana mātou he kaiako matatau ana i te reo Māori ki Tāmaki ki te Tonga mai te Mane ki te Paraire ia te wiki a haere ake nei. He tūranga ukiuki tēnei. He mātanga Reo Māori te kaitono ka ekea ki tēnei tūranga. E mau I toona reehita whakaako tamariki hoki. Kia mohio hoki ki te whakaako tamariki Tau 9 - 13 ki te whakamahi I Te Marautanga o Aotearoa me te whakamahi I Te NCEA te whainga matua mo tenei tuuranga. Mehemea he tangata ngakaunui koe ki ngaa kaupapa nui, te mahitahi ki ngaa hoa mahi, teenaa Whakapaa mai! Ko te tuumanako ka waatea te kaitono Kia timata I teenei turanga hei te waa tata tonu nei. We seek a keen and enthusiastic te reo Māori kaiako to join our school. Applicants should be confident in teaching junior and senior students. Applicants should have a current New Zealand teacher registration and a working knowledge of the New Zealand Curriculum. The successful applicant will have: * proven classroom management skills and ability to create a positive and inclusive learning environment for all ākonga * a commitment to the progress of all ākonga * ability to work collaboratively to raise student achievement * will whakamana the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and ensure te reo me ōna tikanga is upheld * be adaptable with a willingness to explore differentiated teaching and learning approaches. * Commitment to relational pedagogy and restorative practices. A commitment to mana ōrite mō te Mātauranga Māori, and cultural responsiveness is also essential. Posted Date: 21 August 2026

#### **Kaihautū te Tari Māori 3 MU + 1 MMA** · **Full Time/Permanent** ‍He ngaakau maahaki taau moo Te Reo Maaori me oona Tikanga? He tangata matatau koe ki te koorero, aarahi me whakaako i Te Reo Maaori.  E rapu ana maatou i teetahi Kaihautuu Maaori hei whakaako i aa maatou aakonga mai te Tau 9 ki te Tau 13. Ki te mahi tahi me te whakahaere i eetahi atu kaiako e rua, i roto i te tari Maaori. Kia whakahaere i ngaa poowhiri o te kura. He kaiako koe e matatau ana i ngaa Taumata Maatauranga aa-motu (NCEA) i Te Reo Maaori tae mai te reanga iwa ki te taumata tuatoru. Ko te tumanako, ka whakauu tonu te tuuranga nei ki te tuuhono atu ki te mana whenua, araa too maatou hapuu o Ngaati Tamaoho. Ko te tumanako, ka whakatinanahia ngaa whakarerekeetanga i roto i te tari Maaori a teeraa tau, kia haangai ki Te Maataiaho maatauranga. Mehemea kei a koe ngaa puukenga katoa, teenaa tono mai. Do you have a passion for Māori Language and its culture? Are you someone who is able to speak fluently, guide and teach in Te Reo Māori.  We are looking for a Head of Faculty Māori to teach our year 9 - 13 students. To work alongside and manage two other teachers within the department. To run pōwhiri as required. You are a teacher that has strong grounding in NCEA levels 1-3 with its associated requirements, and the relevant clarifications of the standards for the academic success of our students. An ability to be able to make connections with our local Hapū of Ngāti Tamaoho is also desired. There is an expectation that changes be implemented within the Māori Department next year to align with the National Curriculum Refresh. Posted Date: 3 August 2026
